sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000043-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 043 on February 14, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 1,360 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
